name: Example: Gem Colours
author: byo-pop examples
description: More or fewer kinds of gem. Fewer make matches and long cascades easy; more make them rare. Gems past the seventh are drawn from the white gem in new tints, each with a small mark in the corner, unless a mod above this one draws them. Uses its own high-score table.

settings.label: Kinds of gem
settings.help: The original has 7. A mod with more gem art, such as su-gems or code-art, draws up to 11 or 12.
